campaign.name: SE | Search | VVS | Gratis samtalsaudit | 30D
campaign.initialCpcRule: min(60, max(25, Keyword Planner median low-range top-of-page bid))

stopRules: Pause immediately if tracking, form, or calendar confirmation breaks
Add negatives if irrelevant searches exceed 20% of the latest 20 clicks
Pause a keyword or search theme after 600 SEK with no audit submission
Pause the campaign at 2,000 SEK with no qualified leads
Stop at 4,000 SEK regardless of unfinished learning
Stop acquisition at five paid pilots in a rolling 30-day period
scaleRules: One pilot and CAC <= 4,000 SEK allows a 6,000 SEK month-two cap
Two pilots and CAC <= 2,000 SEK allows an 8,000 SEK month-two cap
